body.statement: For \(p\geq3\), fixed \(\iota\), and finite \(\Xi\), the procedure terminates after at most \(G_{\#}2^{c_{\max}}+G_{\#}2^{b_{\max}}+(G_{\#}+\binom{G_{\#}}{2})4^{b_{\max}}\) chart or objective leaves and \(\mathfrak B(\Xi)\) outward-rounded operations. It rejects \(\rho\notin\Delta_J^{\mathbb Q}\) before covariance or required-well evaluation. A \(\mathtt{CERTIFIED}\) output proves full rank; normalized allocation with \(\rho_j>0\) for every composition row entering the unpooling map; valid chart coverage; positive exact untruncated bounds \(\Gamma_{\mathcal T}\geq\underline\Gamma_{\mathcal T}\), \(\kappa_{\mathcal T}\geq\underline\kappa_{\mathcal T}\), \(\Lambda_{\mathcal T}(r_{\mathrm{id}})\geq\underline\Lambda_{\mathcal T}(r_{\mathrm{id}})\), and \(\mu_{\mathcal T}(r_{\mathrm{id}};\mathscr C)\geq\underline\mu_{\mathcal T}(r_{\mathrm{id}};\mathscr C)\); positive interiority; the recorded tail and variance bounds; and \(N_{\mathrm{req}}\leq N_{\max}\). For an empty wrong-graph comparison or remote-pair set, the corresponding exact and certified bounds are \(+\infty\) and impose no numerical check. A \(\mathtt{REFUTED}\) output proves its named obstruction; \(\mathtt{UNDECIDED}\) makes no substantive claim. If all nonvacuous exact inequalities have strict slack and the deterministic chart construction admits strict strong-monotonicity bounds, sufficiently large finite truncation, subdivision, Taylor, and precision controls produce \(\mathtt{CERTIFIED}\).
body.justification: This is the proof-producing kernel with distinct global identification, local regularity, and precision outputs.
body.gap: Rump, Kearfott, and Berz--Makino do not jointly propagate Poisson-PGF tails through graph exclusion, global within-graph identification, singular values, covariance, and intervention precision.
body.consumer: It turns a prospective choice of composition, grid, model boxes, and computational budget into an auditable go, stop, or undecided decision.
